LanguageData.LC_Setting_RemoveCookSkill: Remove cook skill from food poisoning
LanguageData.LC_Setting_RemoveCookSkillDesc: Vanilla rolls food poisoning against the cook's Cooking skill in addition to kitchen cleanliness, so a low-skill cook poisons meals even in a spotless kitchen. With this on, cook skill no longer causes poisoning; only cleanliness does.
LanguageData.LC_Setting_LocalCleanliness: Use nearby cleanliness instead of whole-room average
LanguageData.LC_Setting_LocalCleanlinessDesc: Measure cleanliness locally around the spot where the work happens (the stove or the bed), weighting nearby tiles most and ignoring tiles beyond the radius or behind a wall, instead of the flat average over the whole room. Reuses vanilla cleanliness values and curves.
LanguageData.LC_Setting_RadiusDesc: How far from the work spot cleanliness is sampled. Smaller means only the tiles right next to the stove or bed matter.
LanguageData.LC_Setting_FalloffDesc: How sharply nearer tiles outweigh farther ones. 1 is a straight linear falloff to the radius edge; higher values concentrate the weight on the tiles closest to the work spot.
